hell_merchant.name: Tormented Peddler
hell_merchant.description: A twisted soul who trades in suffering... and useful goods.

demon_sorcerer.name: Infernal Magister
demon_sorcerer.description: A powerful demon who teaches the dark arts... for a price.

wandering_sage.name: Wandering Sage
wandering_sage.description: A mysterious figure who can unlock your hidden potential.

weapon_master.name: Weapon Master
weapon_master.description: A grizzled veteran who teaches combat techniques.

frozen_merchant.name: Frozen Merchant
frozen_merchant.description: Frost-covered wares from a resilient trader in the frozen wastes.

ember_merchant.name: Ember Merchant
ember_merchant.description: Fire-forged goods from the burning half of Naraka. Everything radiates warmth.

wandering_peddler.name: Wandering Peddler
wandering_peddler.description: Eclectic trinkets and supplies scavenged from the frozen wastes.

general_store.name: General Store
general_store.description: A well-stocked shop with a bit of everything.

hell_tavern.name: Devil's Rest
hell_tavern.description: A dim roadhouse where the desperate gather. Someone at the bar looks like they're between allegiances.

hell_teahouse_cold.name: Teahouse
hell_teahouse_cold.description: A dim waystation where the desperate catch their breath. The barkeeper keeps a pot of Lapsang Souchong going — its smoke is the closest thing to warmth in the frozen wastes.

hell_teahouse_fire.name: Teahouse
hell_teahouse_fire.description: The tea here is brewed in volcanic water. It tastes like char and smoke and something almost familiar. The barkeeper doesn't ask where you've been.

hell_mercenary_guild.name: Mercenary Guild
hell_mercenary_guild.description: A fortified post where demonic soldiers hire out between assignments. Their equipment is functional, their prices are fair, their loyalty is negotiable.

hell_veterans_camp.name: Veterans' Camp
hell_veterans_camp.description: A camp of soldiers who survived long enough to have something to teach. They charge for lessons — nothing is free in hell.

hell_yogini_circle.name: Yogini Circle
hell_yogini_circle.description: A circle of Dakinis — fierce, half-wild tantric practitioners. They trade knowledge for gold and ask no questions about what you plan to do with it.

hell_town_weapons.name: Town
hell_town_weapons.description: A cluster of hovels that qualifies as a settlement. The main trade here is war.

hell_town_magic.name: Town
hell_town_magic.description: A settlement that has drawn more than its share of sorcerers and wandering scholars. The apothecary is always busy.

hell_town_supplies.name: Town
hell_town_supplies.description: A trading post that survives on practicality. The sign reads: FOOD. TOOLS. NO CREDIT. It is the most honest thing you have seen in hell.

hell_sacred_grove.name: Sacred Grove
hell_sacred_grove.description: The dappled light streaming through the dense canopy seems like living gold. The Yakshas and Yakshinis come to commune with their followers in this place, marked with colored ropes on the tree trunks and prayer flags hanging from the branches.

hell_temple_of_the_naga.name: Temple of the Naga
hell_temple_of_the_naga.description: In every world some beings are born innately attuned to the mindstreams of the Naga. Temples arise where they practice, communing with their reptilian friends and patrons through offerings of saffron milk, fruits and flowers.

hell_garuda_roost.name: Garuda Roost
hell_garuda_roost.description: A tall pole with a horned symbol at the top rises from the ground, sacred stones and offerings heaped at its base, colorful ribbons fluttering in the wind. The worshippers say the Garudas come to perch at the top during their long travels.

hell_hidden_gompa.name: Hidden Gompa
hell_hidden_gompa.description: Practitioners come to this place seeking solitude and peace. The ground itself vibrates with the power of their meditation, mantric syllables appearing spontaneously in the rock.

hell_mirror_lake.name: Mirror Lake
hell_mirror_lake.description: Mirages flicker over the mercurial surface of the lake. Followers of the Goddess of Illusion gather around, meditating on the fleeting nature of phenomena and exchanging stories of their dreams.

hell_crossroads_stupa.name: Crossroads Stupa
hell_crossroads_stupa.description: The wind carries the smell of sacred juniper smoke and sacrificial wine far from this place. As you come closer, you see little heaps of tormas and butter lamps, some still burning.

hell_circle_of_yoginis.name: Circle of the Yoginis
hell_circle_of_yoginis.description: The inward-facing side of this circular stone wall is carved with the bizarre forms of sixty four Yoginis. There is no ceiling, so the witches can land when they come flying from vast space to meet their earthly sisters.

hell_medicinal_garden.name: Medicinal Garden
hell_medicinal_garden.description: The air is vibrant with the aroma of medicinal herbs and flowers. The healers cultivating them are happy to share some of their knowledge for the benefit of all suffering beings.

hell_eternal_fire.name: Temple of the Eternal Fire
hell_eternal_fire.description: Priests clad in white robes have been guarding the sacred fire since time immemorial. Many come to pay their respects and seek visions in the dancing flames.

hell_black_lodge.name: Black Lodge
hell_black_lodge.description: The entrance is half-buried in the earth, marked only with a crooked khatvanga topped with a skull and streaming black ribbons reeking of smoke and poison. As you enter, the darkness overwhelms you - until you notice the glint of a sneering smile.

hg_bone_merchant.name: Bone Merchant
hg_bone_merchant.description: A skeleton trader squats among the dry graves, its jaw clicking as it counts coins with bony fingers. The wares are crude but functional — carved from the bones of those who no longer need them.

hg_charnel_sorcerer.name: Charnel Sorcerer
hg_charnel_sorcerer.description: A vetala perches atop a crumbling funerary monument, its stolen body draped in rotting silk. It trades in dark knowledge — curses, poisons, and the thin art of pulling life from the dying.

hg_wandering_preta.name: Wandering Preta
hg_wandering_preta.description: A gaunt, distended figure with a neck like a needle and a belly like a drum. It clutches its wares with desperate hands, willing to trade food for almost anything — though it can never eat enough to be satisfied.

hg_teahouse.name: The Last Cup
hg_teahouse.description: A lantern glows faintly above a low doorway carved into a burial mound. Inside, a quiet figure brews tea from dried flowers that grow only on graves. The dead do not drink, but the living are welcome to rest.

hg_town_weapons.name: Crossbones Armory
hg_town_weapons.description: A squat stone building marked with crossed femurs above the door. The smith inside is alive — barely — and forges weapons from scavenged iron and whatever the gravediggers bring in.

hg_town_magic.name: Whispering Shrine
hg_town_magic.description: Faded prayer flags hang from a cracked shrine where the boundary between the living and dead has worn thin. The priests here teach what they remember of the old arts — healing and hexing in equal measure.

hg_town_supplies.name: Gravedigger's Supply
hg_town_supplies.description: A practical establishment run by those who tend to the dead for a living. The shelves are well stocked — people always need supplies in a land where nothing grows.

hg_mercenary_guild.name: Undertakers' Lodge
hg_mercenary_guild.description: A fortified charnel house where the realm's hired fighters gather between jobs. They call themselves undertakers — they put things in the ground, one way or another.

hg_veterans_camp.name: The Old Guard
hg_veterans_camp.description: A ring of tents around a guttering fire, where warriors who have survived the hungry ghost realm long enough gather to share what they know. Their eyes have the hollow look of those who have seen too much decay.

hg_alchemist.name: The Dré Herbalist
hg_alchemist.description: A dré ghost crouches behind a folding table heaped with dried herbs, stoppered gourds, and bundles of something that smells like incense and rot. Its robes are stuffed so full of plant matter that it looks like a walking thicket. It speaks in a dry rasp and seems to genuinely enjoy its trade.

hg_black_market.name: The Smuggler's Alcove
hg_black_market.description: A low tunnel behind a false wall, lit by a single floating ember. The figure inside won't show its face. It trades in things that shouldn't have made it into the hungry ghost realm — quality ironwork, foreign medicines, a few items with the smell of other worlds still on them. Prices reflect the difficulty of getting anything here at all.

hg_spell_shop.name: The Bone Library
hg_spell_shop.description: A sorcerer-ghost has assembled a collection of sutras and grimoires, most of them water-stained or singed at the edges, all of them legible to those with the patience to study. It charges for access by the session — a small candle's worth of time per spell — and answers no questions that aren't paid for.

infernal_forge.name: Infernal Forge
infernal_forge.description: Heat-warped iron, a bone-white anvil, and a demon who hasn't slept in three hundred years. The weapons here are ugly and they work.

bone_archer_camp.name: Bone Archer Camp
bone_archer_camp.description: A fortified camp of skeleton archers who've been here long enough to start trading. Their fletching is excellent. Their interpersonal skills are not.

mercy_ward.name: Mercy Ward
mercy_ward.description: A tent with clean bandages, a smell of herbs, and a medic who patches up anyone who can pay — no questions, no karma, no judgment. In hell this is rare enough to be miraculous.

brimstone_lab.name: Brimstone Lab
brimstone_lab.description: A rickety structure of cracked glass and boiling tubes. The alchemist here has survived seventeen explosions. This gives them a certain confidence.

wardens_pit.name: Warden's Pit
wardens_pit.description: The pit warden runs the eastern patrols and teaches her soldiers to fight. For coin she'll train outsiders too — up to a point. She has standards.

steam_domain_shop.name: Secrets of the Bathhouse
steam_domain_shop.description: The old frog settles onto the edge of the pool, pours two cups of tea, and begins to talk. What it knows about steam and the place where water meets fire cannot be found in any guild.

rainbow_domain_shop.name: Teachings of the Skygazing Gompa
rainbow_domain_shop.description: The yogi shares what they know of the rainbow body and the prismatic nature of mind. These spells cannot be found in any guild.

tummo_domain_shop.name: The Hermit's Fire
tummo_domain_shop.description: The hermit teaches the inner fire — the heat that blazes upward from the secret chakra and melts the crown. These practices cannot be found in any guild.

luminosity_domain_shop.name: Teachings of the Dark Cave
luminosity_domain_shop.description: The unseen teacher shares what they know of the clear light. These practices cannot be found in any guild.

sound_domain_shop.name: The Gandharva's Gift
sound_domain_shop.description: The gandharva prince teaches the art of sound — mantra, resonance, and the spaces between notes. These arts cannot be found in any guild.

animal_forest_teahouse.name: Forest Teahouse
animal_forest_teahouse.description: A platform structure high in the canopy, reachable by rope bridges from three directions. The vanara who run it have been doing so since before any of them can remember. The tea is brewed from forest herbs you don't recognize and tastes like rain, bark, and something that is not quite spice.

animal_meadow_teahouse.name: Meadow Teahouse
animal_meadow_teahouse.description: A circular tent-structure at a major watering hole, serving travelers and migrants and the occasional khadga who has learned to sit still long enough to drink something warm. The yaksha proprietor brews from the seasonal grass-flowers and charges exactly what the market will bear.

animal_ocean_teahouse.name: Tide Shelter
animal_ocean_teahouse.description: A structure built into a sea cliff, half-submerged at high tide and bone-dry at low. A fire burns in a sealed alcove. The keeper is a broad and unhurried makara current who settled down forty years ago and has been pouring the same tea blend since. Nobody asks the recipe.

animal_forest_training_camp.name: Forest Training Camp
animal_forest_training_camp.description: A gana training ground deep in the canopy — worn wooden practice posts, rope courses strung between trees, the smell of exertion and leaf-litter. The instructors are scarred veterans who have survived things that don't have names yet.

animal_meadow_training_camp.name: Meadow Training Camp
animal_meadow_training_camp.description: An open-air training ground where the wind comes from every direction at once. The dura instructors here believe that there is no better teacher than exposure, and schedule sparring sessions during the hour before the bhramara cloud arrives.

animal_ocean_training_camp.name: Reef Training Camp
animal_ocean_training_camp.description: A karka war-school built into the coral. Sessions alternate between fighting in the shallows and fighting in open water, on the grounds that you will never get to choose. The instructors communicate primarily by demonstration.

animal_mercenary_guild.name: Mercenary Guild
animal_mercenary_guild.description: Animals who have figured out that their skills have cash value and have the good sense to organize. Better equipment than you might expect. The guild master keeps the contracts brief and the payment terms clear.

animal_town_weapons.name: Town
animal_town_weapons.description: A market where different territories agree, briefly, to exchange. Dura shell-wright craftsmanship, vanara jugaad improvisation, shardula-claw handles on daggers sold by gana traders who got them somewhere no one is explaining. The weapons here are practical and tell stories.

animal_town_magic.name: Town
animal_town_magic.description: A settlement that has drawn its share of hedge-mages, ritual practitioners, and wandering herbalists. The apothecary smells of bark, fungal spores, and something resinous that's been burning for days.

animal_town_supplies.name: Town
animal_town_supplies.description: A clearing settlement where four game trails meet. Sounder matrons and herb-walkers tend most of the stalls. Food preserved in bark and clay, medicines extracted from things most travelers walk past without recognizing, tools for the deep wild. It is honest trade in a place that doesn't demand credentials.

animal_sacred_grove.name: Sacred Grove
animal_sacred_grove.description: The oldest trees in the realm gather here as if in council. Bark-sigils accumulate on the trunks over centuries — offerings pressed into the wood, prayers absorbed by the roots. The Yakshas and Yakshinis who maintain this grove are older than the realm's current configuration.

animal_temple_of_the_naga.name: Temple of the Naga
animal_temple_of_the_naga.description: An old structure where those born with naga-affinity come to train under the great serpents' direct guidance. The water here has properties that don't exist anywhere else in the realm. Offerings of saffron milk and river-flowers are accepted at the outer shrine.

animal_garuda_roost.name: Garuda Roost
animal_garuda_roost.description: A great landing pole rises above the canopy, hung with wind-bells and sky-prayer flags. The Garudas who use it leave residual power in the ground below. Practitioners of air and space magic come here to feel the difference between flight and fall.

animal_hidden_gompa.name: Hidden Gompa
animal_hidden_gompa.description: A monastery that exists only insofar as the practice of its inhabitants sustains it. The walls are older than memory and the silence deeper than the forest. The practitioners here have been undisturbed for long enough that the ground itself has opinions.

animal_mirror_lake.name: Mirror Lake
animal_mirror_lake.description: The surface shows things that aren't there — or rather, things that are there but not yet. Followers of the Goddess of Illusion use this as a training ground: if you can hold your mind still enough to see clearly in a place that specializes in confusion, you can do it anywhere.

animal_yogini_circle.name: Yogini Circle
animal_yogini_circle.description: Sixty-four Yoginis carved in relief on an inward-facing ring of stone, no ceiling, no door. The practitioners who gather here are a rougher assembly than the hidden gompa — interested in results more than elegance, and willing to discuss the dangerous schools.

animal_medicinal_garden.name: Medicinal Garden
animal_medicinal_garden.description: A cultivated clearing tended by practitioners who have studied the relationship between plant, body, and suffering for generations. The herbs here grow things that have no equivalent elsewhere. Knowledge is shared freely; materials cost what they cost.

animal_eternal_fire.name: Temple of the Eternal Fire
animal_eternal_fire.description: White-robed priests have tended this fire since before the realm's current configuration. The animals who come here for vision-seeking say the fire speaks differently than any other source of light — more direct, less patient.

animal_black_lodge.name: Black Lodge
animal_black_lodge.description: Half-buried, marked with a khatvanga hung with black ribbons and bone-charms. The practitioners here study predation as a spiritual technology — what it means to take life, what it transfers. The animal realm is uncommonly honest about the subject.

animal_crossroads_stupa.name: Crossroads Stupa
animal_crossroads_stupa.description: Where four major migration routes intersect, a stupa marks the conjunction. Tormas and butter lamps heap at its base, some kept burning by passing devotees, some long guttered out. The practitioners here specialize in working with beings rather than forces.

animal_ancient_banyan.name: The Ancient Banyan
animal_ancient_banyan.description: A banyan so old it has become its own forest — hundreds of aerial roots, each descended root a new trunk, the whole organism covering ground that would take an hour to walk around. The beings who live inside its aerial forest do not remember when they arrived.

animal_birds_congress.name: Birds' Congress
animal_birds_congress.description: A high cliff where every species of bird in the realm sends at least one representative, continuously, by some rotation that appears to involve song but which scholars cannot fully decode. What looks like a congress is also, apparently, a school.

animal_bone_forest.name: Bone Forest
animal_bone_forest.description: A forest of pale calcified trees — not dead but transformed, turned to mineral over geological time. The predators who come here to meditate among the skeletal forms have access to a school of thought that treats death not as an ending but as a material.

animal_naga_palace.name: Naga Palace
animal_naga_palace.description: The seat of a naga court that remembers when this ocean was fresh water. Trading access: the naga have long memories and are interested in what traveling parties have seen. Their price for advanced teaching is always information — specific, verifiable, and something they don't already know.

animal_termite_cathedral.name: Termite Cathedral
animal_termite_cathedral.description: A structure ten meters high, built over centuries by beings each the size of a thumbnail, with architectural precision that confounds engineers. The collective intelligence that designed and maintains it doesn't communicate in any language known to surface beings, but it does teach — by implication and exposure.

smoke_domain_shop.name: Vision of the Smoking Mirror
smoke_domain_shop.description: The mirror teaches, in the way mirrors do — by showing rather than telling. What it shows about smoke, shadow, and the nature of reflected things cannot be found in any guild.

mud_domain_shop.name: Teachings of the Pit
mud_domain_shop.description: The mudlings share what they know of deep earth — the patience of silt, the memory of clay, the slow power of things that have been compressed for a very long time. These arts cannot be found in any guild.

cloud_domain_shop.name: Teachings of the Cloud Palace
cloud_domain_shop.description: The gandharvas and apsaras of the Cloud Palace teach the sky arts — what it means to move like weather, to see from altitude, to become the medium through which lightning travels. These arts cannot be found in any guild.

glass_domain_shop.name: Secrets of the Glass Mountain
glass_domain_shop.description: The mountain teaches through its own nature — perfect transparency, perfect hardness, perfect memory of having once been scattered sand. What it knows about clarity and cutting cannot be found in any guild.

crystal_domain_shop.name: Teachings of the Crystal Cave
crystal_domain_shop.description: The elder yogi has been here long enough to have grown into the crystals themselves — or the crystals have grown into him. Either way, what he knows about resonance, focus, and geometric mind cannot be found in any guild.

hg_black_lodge.name: Black Lodge
hg_black_lodge.description: A mound of bones marks the entrance, a khatvanga hung with a skull and black silk. Inside, something moves that may not be fully alive. It knows what you want.

hg_circle_of_yoginis.name: Circle of the Yoginis
hg_circle_of_yoginis.description: Sixty-four forms carved into standing bones, forming a ring on the charnel ground. The earth inside is worn smooth by countless ritual footprints. The witches still come.

hg_crossroads_stupa.name: Crossroads Stupa
hg_crossroads_stupa.description: At the intersection of the ancient paths, a stupa rises from layers of offerings — skulls, prayer flags, bones wrapped in cloth. The practitioners here call back what has been lost.

hg_hidden_gompa.name: Hidden Gompa
hg_hidden_gompa.description: A small monastery sits undisturbed between the burial grounds, its walls marked with painted eyes. The monks here practice for the benefit of all beings caught between lives.

hg_mirror_lake.name: Mirror Lake
hg_mirror_lake.description: The surface of the lake reflects not the sky but something else — other realms, other moments. Practitioners sit at its edge, learning to bend what is seen.

hg_sacred_grove.name: Sacred Grove
hg_sacred_grove.description: A stand of ancient trees whose roots grow through charnel earth. Offerings of food hang from the branches — the hungry ghosts can smell them but cannot eat. Practitioners here speak to both the living and the dead.

hg_temple_of_the_naga.name: Temple of the Naga
hg_temple_of_the_naga.description: A low temple built around a black-water pool. The nagas who dwell in such pools are guardians of the dead. Their human followers leave milk offerings at the water's edge and learn what the serpents are willing to teach.

spell_trainer.description: Teaches spells, may sell magical items

skill_trainer.description: Trains skills and attributes, may sell items

mixed.description: Offers items, spells, and possibly training

mercenary_guild.description: Weapons, armour, and fighters for hire

veteran_camp.description: Combat skill training and veterans for hire

yogini_circle.description: Spells, magic supplies, and spiritual companions

spell_guild.description: Teaches a fixed curriculum of spells in one school. Curriculum is stable per location.

blacksmith.description: Weapons, armor, and weapon oils; buys equipment

fletcher.description: Ranged weapons, throwables, and light armor; buys equipment

healer.description: Healing supplies and white magic spells

alchemist.description: Potions, bombs, oils, and alchemy training

crystal_domain_shop.name: The Yogi's Teaching
crystal_domain_shop.description: The yogi shares what he knows with those who approach in the right spirit. The spells he teaches are not found in any guild.

glass_domain_shop.name: Fragments of the Glass Mountain
glass_domain_shop.description: Knowledge cut from the mountain itself. Impossibly sharp, perfectly clear. These spells cannot be found in any guild.

smoke_domain_shop.name: Whispers of the Shattered Mirror
smoke_domain_shop.description: Knowledge gleaned from smoke and reflection. These arts cannot be taught in any guild — only glimpsed in the mirror's darkness.

mud_domain_shop.name: Mudling Elder's Teaching
mud_domain_shop.description: The elder mudling has agreed to teach the secrets of mud-working. These spells cannot be found in any guild — buy now or lose the chance.

steam_domain_shop.name: The Frog-Spirit's Teaching
steam_domain_shop.description: The old frog settles onto the edge of the pool, pours two cups of tea, and begins to talk. What it knows about steam and the place where water meets fire cannot be found in any guild.

cloud_domain_shop.name: Songs of the Cloud Nagas
cloud_domain_shop.description: The nagas coil around you, humming in their deep rain-voices. What they know of cloud and sky and the space between water and air cannot be found in any guild — and will not be offered twice.
